title: An optimized TCN–LSTM model for predicting PM2.5 in metro systems
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,1951-1959
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00249D, Paper
Canyun Yang, Zhang Kai, Xinyuan Wang, Tong Hu, Hongbin Liu
